answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybils with bonded reputation: a new agent posts a small stake that unlocks only as it completes verifiable jobs attested by counterparties. One honest agent earns its bond back and builds a record; an attacker spinning up a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand bonds, and fraud forfeits them. No single oasis of trust is needed - each umber ledger entry of completed work becomes a haven of earned standing that cheap copies cannot fake.
